title: CEO自曝低估：实际多出10万，五年布局兑现
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I want to talk about execution. There's so many issues to talk about with your company, but just execution. These numbers this morning, John, the streets are looking for like 325,000.
segments.zh: 我想谈谈执行力。贵公司有很多话题可聊，但先看执行力。今早的数据，约翰，市场预期约32.5万。

segments.en: And you deliver 432,000 monthly wireless phone subscribers in 2Q.
segments.zh: 而你们二季度新增了43.2万无线电话用户。

segments.en: What went right, John? What was the strategy behind, again, that big?
segments.zh: 做对了什么，约翰？背后的策略是什么，再次取得如此大的成绩？

segments.en: Well, I think going into the break, John, I think you referred to the results as fantastic, and I would agree with you. And I think the team did an excellent job executing, as you said.
segments.zh: 嗯，进入休息前，约翰，你称结果很棒，我同意。团队执行出色，如你所说。

segments.en: And it's not just in our wireless business. It was nearly 370,000 fiber net ads.
segments.zh: 不仅无线业务，光纤净增近37万。

segments.en: That's a record for us in this quarter. Look, what went right is what we told people was going to happen this year, as we gave guidance for the next three years. We said because of the investments
segments.zh: 这是本季度纪录。做对的是我们年初告诉大家的，未来三年指引中说过，由于过去五年持续定向的**。

segments.en: we've been making in this business over the last five years at a sustained and targeted level.
segments.zh: 以及收购更多频谱和Lumen额外覆盖的并购工作，你们应看到增长提速。

segments.en: And the M&A work that we had done acquiring more spectrum and picking up some additional footprint for Lumen, that you should see a step up in growth as a result of those things.
segments.zh: 团队拥有所需的资产基础来执行并推动更快增长。

segments.en: The team had the asset base that needed to execute and drive growth at a faster level.
segments.zh: 你们在本季度看到了这一点的初步显现。

segments.en: And you saw the manifestation of that starting to happen here in this quarter.
segments.zh: 本季度已开始显现这一趋势。

segments.en: And it's showing up in an accelerated service revenue growth.
segments.zh: 这体现在服务收入加速增长上。

segments.en: It's showing up in accelerated EBITDA growth. I would even go into our business segment and point out that we had growth in our strategic services
segments.zh: 也体现在EBITDA加速增长。甚至在我们业务部门，战略服务也实现了久违的增长。

segments.en: for business for the first time in a very, very long time.
segments.zh: 这是很长时间以来首次出现。
